query:
WITH to_touch AS MATERIALIZED (
                            SELECT id FROM job_executions
                            WHERE poller_instance_id = $2
                              AND state = 'running'
                              AND id = ANY($3)
                            ORDER BY queue_id, id
                            FOR NO KEY UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
                        )
                        UPDATE job_executions je
                        SET alive_at = $1
                        FROM to_touch t
                        WHERE je.id = t.id
